game_title: Backpack Append – Fallen Statue Garden Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Backpack Append: Use append and remove to manage the spirit seeker's backpack list as stone sentinels drop loot.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Use append and remove to manage the spirit seeker's backpack list as stone sentinels drop loot. Each round, stone sentinels strike the ancient lock, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the bag_space value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ancient lock from stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden: keep the bag_space meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: bag_space drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Backpack Append
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Backpack Append' (Week 7 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bag_space changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while bag_space > 0.
